craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at contemplating-going — exultation register: trust-and-freedom song. Vague-clear flashed by difference; two-who-know kept. Rejected: (a) vague→dim → killed: vague keeps exact inexactness. Read aloud: BLISS, WILL, LORD-ship … KNOWN-flash-ing FOR the-TWO who-KNOW.

lines: Bliss, will, lordship, opening, lack — and will's lordship
vague, clear, by difference — known flashing for the two who know.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ānandeccheśanonmeṣā ūnatā ceśanecchayoḥ asphuṭasphuṭabhedena vedyollāsas tayor vidaḥ
